description: Models and tools orchestrated through predefined code paths. Your code decides the order of steps; the model fills each one in.
A system where the model dynamically directs its own process and tool use, inside limits your code enforces.
Umbrella term for workflows and agents alike, as used in Anthropic's "Building effective agents".
The building block of both shapes: a model call enhanced with retrieval, tools and memory.
Per-step error rates multiply over a run: 95% per step gives about 60% over 10 independent steps.
Using an agent where a fixed workflow would do, paying cost, latency and unpredictability for no gain.
A workflow with one agentic stage, or an agent whose risky actions run through fixed steps such as approvals.
